start.description: Start an idempotent background service through FluentCI’s native workspace service manager and wait for readiness.

project.description: Workspace directory used by every native service manager call. Default: ".".

name.description: Full service name, default module-cassandra-default; must start with module-cassandra- to scope lifecycle operations.

version.description: Docker image version tag. Uses the profile default when omitted; cannot be combined with image.

image.description: Full Docker image reference, including an optional digest; replaces the default repository and version.

port.description: Host port for the primary endpoint; zero allocates an available loopback port. AWS Emulator uses the same nonzero port inside and outside its container. Default: 0.

ports.description: Comma-separated container ports or HOST:CONTAINER bindings. Omit for every profile port with random host bindings. Include the primary port once.

volumes.description: Comma-separated /CONTAINER_PATH anonymous volumes or SOURCE:/CONTAINER_PATH[:ro|rw] mounts. Explicit named/bind data survives stop.

env.description: Comma-separated KEY=VALUE test configuration overrides; no JSON object. Use disposable test values because definitions are sent to the manager.

command.description: Comma-separated foreground command tokens replacing the image command; literal argv, with no shell expansion.

dependsOn.description: Comma-separated existing native service names whose readiness must be satisfied before startup.

startupTimeoutMs.description: Readiness deadline, from 100 to 600000 milliseconds; defaults to the service profile.

stopTimeoutMs.description: Graceful shutdown deadline from 100 to 120000 milliseconds. Default: 5000.

restartPolicy.description: Native restart policy: never, on_failure or always. Default: "never". Allowed values: never, on_failure, always.

maxRestarts.description: Maximum automatic restarts, from zero to 100. Default: 0.

healthCheck.description: Keep running the readiness probe as the native recurring health check. Default: true.

readinessCommand.description: Comma-separated literal probe command run inside the owned container; overrides the profile probe.

readinessPath.description: HTTP readiness URL path for profiles using an HTTP probe.

stop.description: Stop only this named service through the native manager; preserve explicitly mounted data. Native dependents are stopped too.

project.description: Workspace directory used by every native service manager call. Default: ".".

name.description: Full service name, default module-cassandra-default; must start with module-cassandra- to scope lifecycle operations.

restart.description: Restart the existing native service definition and wait for readiness.

status.description: Return the service’s native lifecycle state and actual loopback port bindings.
